rows.rationale: ATLAS imports the original weak-equivalence and cofiber quotient and documents lift uniqueness. It ports the construction and instance uses to the explicitly weaker WaldhausenCategoryWithoutGluing interface without changing the relations.

ATLAS ports the induced map to WaldhausenCategoryWithoutGluing, makes the representative-dependent construction private, and proves naturality of the universal coefficient lift along the induced map on isomorphism classes.
